request.query: cart-service is returning 5xx errors after a deploy

report.summary: During the requested investigation window, cart-service had a threshold-validated 5xx error rate that rose from a near-zero baseline to 15.00pp, while threshold-validated p95 latency remained near 0.23s. Retrieved error logs report NullPointerException at com.shop.cart.PromotionEngine.applyDiscount(PromotionEngine.java:88), tagged version=v1.5.0. This is a plausible source of the errors, but the evidence does not establish that the exception caused the 5xx responses or that the deploy introduced it. The WARN and targeted message queries returned no documents; these absences do not establish service health.

likely_causes.title: Null-handling defect in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount
likely_causes.rationale: The exception at PromotionEngine.java:88 is a plausible application failure mechanism alongside the elevated 5xx rate. The evidence does not correlate individual exceptions to 5xx responses or establish that the deploy introduced the defect.

supporting_evidence.detail: 20 retrieved cart-service ERROR samples report NullPointerException at com.shop.cart.PromotionEngine.applyDiscount(PromotionEngine.java:88), tagged version=v1.5.0; sample timestamps range from 2026-10-26T12:49:35+00:00 to 2026-10-26T13:08:35+00:00.
Threshold-validated cart-service 5xx error rate emerged from a near-zero baseline and reached 15.00pp.

next_steps: Correlate the exception traces with failing requests and response status codes to confirm whether they account for the 5xx errors.
Check the deployment timeline and compare error rates and PromotionEngine behavior across versions to determine whether the deploy introduced the defect.
Inspect inputs and null handling at PromotionEngine.java:88 and validate a fix with targeted tests.
Check request-rate and data-coverage measurements if assessing traffic changes or the timing and continuity of the incident.
